name: @oge-ui/react-spreadsheet
description: React spreadsheet viewer from the OGE UI suite that shows .xlsx workbooks the way Excel does: Excel-measured column widths, row heights, fonts, number formats, borders, fills, conditional formats, frozen panes, merges, pictures, notes and hyperlinks, with Excel's selection, keyboard map, find, copy and status-bar summary — running the same engine and the same stylesheet as the Angular spreadsheet. Dependency-free xlsx reading in the browser. Source-available commercial license (free for evaluation and development).
author: kaya2m
